name: emet-tracking-backend
description: EMET Vegan Cafe order-tracking Lambdas (Stripe → DynamoDB → SNS).
note: AWS SDK v3 (@aws-sdk/*) is preinstalled in the Lambda Node 18/20 runtime and is NOT bundled here. Only `stripe` must ship with the function. See docs/DEPLOY.md for packaging (zip each handler with node_modules, or use a Lambda layer).
